[Thinking]
**Announcing my committee role**

I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My focus is currently on understanding the nuances of this role and how I can best contribute to the project's future initiatives. I'm eager to dive into the details.

**Joining the CDS Hooks Committee**

I'm now on the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My immediate goal is to absorb the operational details and identify impactful ways to shape the project's direction. I'm keen to get involved.

**Contributing to CDS Hooks**

I'm actively engaging with the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My current focus involves synthesizing recent discussions and identifying key areas where I can leverage my experience to influence the project's strategic development moving forward.

**Joining the CDS Hooks Committee**

I'm now part of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My focus is on absorbing the project's current trajectory and identifying areas where I can contribute meaningfully to its ongoing development and adoption.

**Understanding Committee Dynamics**

I'm currently focused on grasping the current committee dynamics and the immediate priorities. My aim is to quickly identify leverage points where my contributions will be most impactful for the CDS Hooks project's advancement.

**Refining Committee Focus**

I'm now actively participating in the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My current efforts are concentrated on synthesizing recent discussions to identify concrete areas where I can contribute to the project's strategic evolution.

**Synthesizing Committee Focus**

I'm currently engrossed in the current committee dynamics and immediate priorities. My goal is to pinpoint leverage points where my contributions will significantly advance the CDS Hooks project.
[/Thinking]

Of course! Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, ranging from a more formal tone to a more casual one. Congratulations on the new role!

### Option 1 (Professional & Direct)

I'm thrilled to announce that I have officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since its early days in 2017, this is a significant and exciting milestone for me. I've seen firsthand how it can bring powerful, real-time clinical decision support directly into the EHR workflow, and I'm eager to collaborate with the community to help guide its evolution.

To that end, I have two calls to action for my network:

1.  **If you are already using CDS Hooks:** Please help us map the ecosystem by adding your implementation to the official wiki. This helps everyone understand the standard's reach and success.
    ➡️ https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

2.  **If you are considering using CDS Hooks:** The barrier to entry is lower than you might think. As a freelance consultant, I am available to help you design and implement a solution tailored to your needs.

Thank you to the Health Level Seven International (HL7) community for this opportunity. I'm looking forward to helping move this vital standard forward.

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #EHR #HealthcareTechnology

---

### Option 2 (More Story-Oriented)

Some exciting personal news! My journey with the CDS Hooks standard began back in 2017. I was immediately drawn to its potential for making clinical decision support smarter, faster, and more seamlessly integrated into a clinician's workflow.

Today, I'm honored to share that I'm taking the next step on that journey by becoming a member of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.

I'm incredibly excited to contribute more formally to the standard's future and help drive its adoption across the industry. I truly believe in its power to improve patient care.

As I step into this new role, I want to connect with the wider community:

-   **Are you already using CDS Hooks?** We want to hear from you! Please add your organization's implementation to the community wiki. It's a huge help for tracking adoption.
    ➡️ https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

-   **Curious about implementing CDS Hooks?** If you're looking to bring event-driven intelligence to your platform but aren't sure where to start, I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate the process.

Let's continue to build a more intelligent and interoperable healthcare ecosystem together!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #HL7 #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #DigitalHealth #Consulting

---

### Option 3 (Short & Punchy - Great for Mobile)

Big news! 🎉 I'm honored to join the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.

My journey with this game-changing standard for clinical decision support began in 2017, and I'm so excited to now have a hand in shaping its future.

I'm ready to get to work, and I need your help!

➡️ **Already using CDS Hooks?**
Please add your implementation to the wiki so we can see all the great work being done!
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

🤔 **Thinking about using it?**
I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you get started. Let's chat about bringing real-time decision support to your workflow.

Excited for what's next in the world of interoperable CDS!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Healthcare #DigitalHealth #Consultant

---

**Pro-Tip:** When you post, consider tagging **Health Level Seven International (HL7)** and any other relevant organizations or influential people in the Health IT space to increase visibility. Congratulations again
